subject: general
question: Which country out of the following is NOT a member of the BRICS group?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BRICS**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sri Lanka **is NOT a member of the **BRICS group**.
 
• **BRICS** is an abbreviation for** Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa**, which are five important developing economies.
 
• The members of the BRICS are renowned for having a considerable impact
